content.title: Kerala High Court Orders Medical Examination for Former DGP
content.caption: Kerala High Court considering a plea by former DGP seeking a modification of his bail conditions to resume employment in UAE.

slides.heading: Background
slides.text: A medical examination may be required to verify former DGP Tomin Thachankary’s illnesses.

slides.heading: Reasons
slides.text: The court needs to know whether it was an illness or a conspiracy to avoid staying in a cell.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: The rule of law must prevail, and the court reserved orders in the plea.
